digest: A single failed VPN authentication for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 was immediately followed by a successful, MFA-confirmed login from the same user and IP. Evidence strongly suggests a user mistyped their password, and no other suspicious activity was observed for this account.

evidence_findings.title: Initial VPN Authentication Failure
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: User 'm.alvarez' experienced a 'vpn-auth-failure' from IP address '198.51.100.24'.
evidence_findings.conclusion: An initial attempt to authenticate to the VPN failed.

evidence_findings.title: Subsequent Successful VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: One minute after the failure, user 'm.alvarez' successfully authenticated to the VPN ('vpn-auth-success') from the same IP address '198.51.100.24'. This login was MFA-confirmed and originated from the user's registered laptop and usual home address.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The user successfully gained access to the VPN, confirming their identity through MFA and using a known device and location.

evidence_findings.title: User Error Indication
evidence_findings.subject: VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.evidence: The failed login is explicitly noted as a 'Password mistyped once at 08:03Z'. There were 'No other failures for this account in the preceding 30 days'.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The single failed authentication event is attributed to user error (mistyped password) rather than a malicious attempt.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: VPN authentication failure for m.alvarez from 198.51.100.24 (password mistyped).
Successful MFA-confirmed VPN authentication for m.alvarez from 198.51.100.24.
